issues.display_title: Issue #1810: Add Payflow Pro failed-payment detection to /cronjob/process-unsubscribes-table
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Extend GET /cronjob/process-unsubscribes-table to also detect dead legacy Payflow Pro recurring profiles (RP...) and queue them for cancellation, mirroring the PayPal detector and reusing the provider-agnostic UnsubscribesSweeper (Phase 2, unchanged).

Findings (live data, 2026-08-29)

  • 127 RP% profiles, 114 with active subscribtion.
  • Payflow INQUIRE returns descriptive STATUS strings, not the documented ACTIVE/INACTIVE/PENDING enum: observed ACTIVE (rp_state=6), DEACTIVATED BY MERCHANT, TOO MANY FAILURES.
  • 3 dead profiles (detector candidates): user 23622 (TOO MANY FAILURES), 27927 & 709 (DEACTIVATED BY MERCHANT).
  • 2 zombie profiles — still ACTIVE with max_fail_payments=0 (unlimited retry): user 1629 (94 consecutive failed payments since 2017), 5641 (93, expired card). Payflow never deactivates them; nothing in our codebase stops billing either.

issues.display_title: Issue #1808: Photographers profile save: forward role/timezone/language fields
issues.main_description_html:
Endpoint: PATCH /photographers/profile/save

Problem: SaveProfileDto only knew 8 fields. Payload fields role, timezone, language were silently dropped in fromArray() / toPayload() — never forwarded to upstream service.

Fix: Added 3 optional nullable fields (role, timezone, language) to SaveProfileDto. Validation handled upstream, no validation added here. Partial update preserved — only non-null fields forwarded.

Files: app/DTOs/Photographers/SaveProfileDto.php

Commit: c50ffcd5c on main
